label: Provider not found
description: The service does not recognise the ordering provider. Selected by the sentinel NPI as well as by the sentinel member ID, so the provider CRD scenario 9 uses gets the same answer here.
basis: Synthetic. Built from this tool's reading of Da Vinci DTR and SDC. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service signals an unknown provider is not known. This file models an HTTP 404 carrying a FHIR OperationOutcome whose issue code is not-found and whose expression names the PractitionerRole.

details.text: No provider matches the NPI supplied.

issue.diagnostics: No provider matches the NPI supplied.
